inspection_method: Frozen WordPress source snapshot + independently viewed official/publisher archival pages. No browser network log, no raw HTTP statuses, no binary downloads.

images.stored_alt: Historical topographic and geological map of Frank and Turtle Mountain showing the town, railway, mine mouth and Frank Slide debris area.
images.viewer_observation: Independent web image viewer decoded exact Image%2003_3.jpg; publisher labels it image 3, a 1903 topographic map sourced to McConnell and Brock 1904.
images.archival_authority: ASCE Geo-Institute; McConnell and Brock (1904) credited as original source
images.rights_note: 1904 source credit does not establish reuse rights for a modern publisher's reproduction; determine original publication/scan license.
images.suggested_credit: McConnell and Brock (1904), as reproduced by ASCE Geo-Institute, pending original-item verification.
images.editorial_caption_note: The map is labeled 1903 by the publisher; retain map date separate from 1904 publication.

images.stored_alt: The mining town of Frank, Alberta, around 1903 with railway cars in the foreground and Turtle Mountain behind the community.
images.viewer_observation: Independent web image viewer decoded the exact upload.wikimedia.org URL; Commons states photo shows Frank BEFORE the 1903 rock slide.
images.archival_authority: Provincial Archives of Alberta A15276 via Commons item description
images.rights_note: Commons gives Canadian public-domain rationale but explicitly notes missing US public-domain tag; US publication clearance must not be inferred.
images.suggested_credit: Provincial Archives of Alberta, A15276; photographer unknown (candidate credit).
images.editorial_caption_note: Add 'before the April 1903 slide' to ALT/caption if confirmed editorially. Avoid visually implying this is the aftermath.

images.stored_alt: Aerial view of Turtle Mountain and the Frank Slide debris field showing North Peak, South Peak, the slide scar and debris across the valley.
images.viewer_observation: Viewer decoded Image%2001_2.jpg: annotated post-slide aerial image with inset location map; publisher labels composite as Image 1, credits Froese et al. (2009).
images.archival_authority: ASCE Geo-Institute; Froese et al. (2009) credited as underlying source
images.rights_note: Modern aerial photograph and inset montage may involve multiple copyright owners; a 2009 citation does not authorize mirroring.
images.suggested_credit: Froese et al. (2009), as reproduced by ASCE Geo-Institute; licensing unverified.
images.editorial_caption_note: Clarify that the image is an annotated aerial composite with inset, not a 1903 photograph.

images.stored_alt: Historical Alberta Geological Survey topographic map of Turtle Mountain showing the Frank Slide area and early hazard analysis.
images.viewer_observation: Viewer decoded the exact AGS query-bearing URL; AGS official caption states John Allan's 1934 danger-zone map, blue small-runout/red large-runout outlines. '720px' is a delivery filename, not independently measured intrinsic width.
images.archival_authority: Alberta Geological Survey / Alberta Energy Regulator
images.candidate_record_id: John A. Allan 1934 danger-zone map; AGS figure-46-720px
images.rights_note: AGS states site materials under Open Government License–Alberta but also cautions non-AGS copyright; image scan includes original 1934 creator. Item-level licence/third-party verification required.
images.suggested_credit: John A. Allan (1934), via Alberta Geological Survey; publisher reproduction terms to verify.
images.editorial_caption_note: Proposed precise ALT: 'John A. Allan’s 1934 map of Turtle Mountain’s Frank Slide danger zones, with blue and red outlines showing smaller and larger projected runout areas.'

images.stored_alt: Wide view of the Frank Slide debris field from Turtle Mountain showing the limestone deposit spanning the Crowsnest Pass valley.
images.viewer_observation: Commons original file page lists 1600×1200 and author/date; direct Special:Redirect/file?width=1280 could not be opened by independent web text viewer, which is NOT proof of a browser failure.
images.rights_note: Commons lists CC BY-SA 3.0 (and GFDL alternative), credit Fourtildas, licence link, modification notice and ShareAlike for adaptations; legal/editorial approval still required.
images.suggested_credit: Fourtildas, 24 September 2006, CC BY-SA 3.0; link original and licence; indicate optimized resize.
